subject: Temporary quota uplift request for Atlas Retail overnight throughput soak
messages:
From: Tom Cheng <tom.cheng@atlasretail.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: overnight throughput soak — temporary quota bump

Hi Ava,

Thanks again for the walkthrough today. We want to run an overnight throughput soak to validate latency and tail behavior for our edge inference route. Planned window: 10pm PT on 2026-09-02 for ~10 hours. Expected sustained qps ~3.5k with occasional short bursts to 5k.

Can Redwood provision a temporary credit/top-up or quota uplift for that window so we don't hit hard limits? We estimate ~1.2M tokens for the run. Attached is a short load plan (atlas_poc_loadplan.xlsx).

Also copying procurement for any paperwork: procurement@atlasretail.com

Appreciate a quick confirmation — we want to avoid any throttling mid-soak.

Cheers,
Tom Cheng
Head of Platform
Atlas Retail
From: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-30T10:04:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: overnight throughput soak — temporary quota bump

Folks — forwarding Atlas Retail's ask. Key points: 10pm PT 2026-09-02, ~10h, ~1.2M tokens, peaks to 5k qps. They need short-term headroom or promo credit to cover the trial run.

Camila — can you confirm the POC health and whether we can route them to a lower-cost model variant temporarily if needed?

Ben — please advise on promo credit approval path and how much we can safely provide without explicit finance escalation. If possible, a one-off promotional credit or temporary quota uplift tied to ATL-POC-317 would be ideal.

Attachments referenced: atlas_poc_loadplan.xlsx (from customer).

Thanks,
Ava Chen
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Finance Ops <finance_ops@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-30T13:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: overnight throughput soak — temporary quota bump

Ava / Camila —

I reviewed the load plan and had a quick sync with Finance Ops. We can approve a one-off promotional credit to cover the estimated usage for the scheduled soak: 
- Amount: equivalent credit for up to 1.5M tokens (safety margin included)
- Window: 2026-09-02 22:00 PT to 2026-09-03 08:00 PT (10h)
- Conditions: credit applied to the Atlas Retail trial account; any run beyond 1.5M tokens will be billed at standard trial rates and we'll contact the customer before charging.

I've attached a stub approval doc (promo-credit-approval-stub.pdf) for recordkeeping and created HubSpot note HS-44592. Finance Ops confirmed no additional contract amendment needed for this one-off.

Camila, please confirm routing suggestions (model variant fallback) so we can include that in the message back to Tom. Lauren, please coordinate with CS to monitor the run and watch for error spikes/tail latency degradation.

Ben Carter
Senior Sales, Redwood Inference

Attachments: promo-credit-approval-stub.pdf
From: Tom Cheng <tom.cheng@atlasretail.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@atlasretail.com, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-31T17:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Temporary quota uplift request for Atlas Retail overnight throughput soak

Ava / Ben / Camila —

This is fantastic, thank you. Confirming we accept the one-off credit up to 1.5M tokens and the proposed window. We'll keep the run within the plan and will pause if you see any concerning errors on your side.

Camila — we'll be ready to drop to the lower-cost variant if you recommend it; please share the exact endpoint name and any tuning suggestions.

Procurement — please consider this email acknowledgement sufficient for scheduling — we'll follow up if you need a purchase order or additional formality.

Thanks again — excited to get the soak data.

—Tom
Head of Platform, Atlas Retail
